summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu sought a targeted operation on Iranian soil before elections, but the U.S. blocked the plan. Iranian air defense activity was reported near Shushtar and the Fifth Fighter Base in Omidiyeh, with an explosion heard at the Strait of Hormuz. Iraqi authorities seized 35 rockets in a truck south of Baghdad, while Israeli forces arrested three Palestinian militants in the West Bank.

Iranian air defense activity was reported near Shushtar and the Fifth Fighter Base in Omidiyeh, with an explosion heard at the Strait of Hormuz. points: Air defense activity detected at Shushtar in Khuzestan Province, indicating heightened alert status near strategic infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/12066)
Air defense activity reported near the Fifth Fighter Base at Omidiyeh in Khuzestan, home to Iranian Air Force tactical squadrons. (Source: @shin_persian/12065)
An explosion was heard from the Strait of Hormuz in Hormozgan Province, a critical maritime chokepoint for global oil transit. (Source: @shin_persian/12062)

A Persian-language nuclear explosion response guide marked "unapproved training version" was reportedly circulated to Iranian healthcare staff, outlining shelter-in-place protocols and radiological casualty management. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9734)

Eight U.S. Air Force tanker aircraft operated over the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, and Gulf of Oman, signaling sustained aerial refueling capacity in the theater. (Source: @shin_persian/12063)
A UAV was launched from the Fifth Fighter Base at Omidiyeh in Khuzestan, demonstrating ongoing unmanned aerial operations from a key fighter installation. (Source: @shin_persian/12060)
Prime Minister Netanyahu sought to execute a targeted strike on Iranian soil days before elections; Mossad chief supported the plan but U.S. intervention blocked it. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9719)

Israeli political leadership has not instructed the IDF to prepare for a strike on Iran following U.S. midterm elections, though officials consider such an order a possibility. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9721)
The Prime Minister's Office stated Israel has a strong economy in response to reports of a halt in U.S. security assistance. (Source: @yediotnews25/137395)
IDF has ceased updating the Palestinian Authority before operations in the West Bank due to concerns over leaks to militants. (Source: @yediotnews25/137398)
Former Chief of Staff Eisenkot outlined a minority government of 48 Knesset seats reliant on external Arab support and potential Haredi abstention. (Source: @amitsegal/66909)

Duvdevan special forces, directed by Shin Bet intelligence, arrested three militants in the West Bank villages of Al-Amari, Al-Ram, and Al-Bira in the Benjamin Brigade area who were planning terror attacks against Israeli civilians and forces. (Source: @yediotnews25/137394)
IDF stopped sharing operational plans with the Palestinian Authority prior to West Bank raids due to fears of intelligence leaks to militant groups. (Source: @yediotnews25/137398)
Fire sweeping or artillery shelling reported at Aita al-Jabal in southern Lebanon, indicated by live map alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51949)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Saluqi in southern Lebanon, indicated by live map alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51915)
Lebanese Army conducted a controlled explosion in the town of Al-Haniyeh; no security incident reported. (Source: @redlinkleb/51958)
Iraqi security forces arrested three individuals south of Baghdad after discovering 35 rockets inside a truck, according to Al Hadath. (Source: @shin_persian/12058)
An Iraqi government aircraft departed Tehran after an eight-hour visit, indicating high-level diplomatic engagement between Baghdad and Tehran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9727)

Eight USAF tankers were tracked over the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, and Gulf of Oman, reflecting robust U.S. aerial refueling presence across Gulf airspace. (Source: @shin_persian/12063)
The U.S. imposed new sanctions targeting eight entities based in Canada linked to Iran, per Treasury Department designation. (Source: @N12chat/233754)

FinCEN ordered MEXC Global cut off from the U.S. financial system for facilitating at least $16 billion in illicit transactions tied to Iranian, North Korean, and Russian sanctions evasion, including $22 million involving the Central Bank of Iran and IRGC-Qods Force. (Source: @shin_persian/12069)

sections.threat_assessment: Iranian air defense activations at Shushtar and Omidiyeh, coupled with a UAV launch from the Fifth Fighter Base and an explosion at the Strait of Hormuz, suggest Tehran is maintaining a high alert posture amid fears of an Israeli strike. The presence of eight USAF tankers across Gulf airspace indicates sustained U.S. power projection and potential support for Israeli operations. Iraq's seizure of 35 rockets bound for militant groups underscores the persistent threat of proxy attacks on Israeli and U.S. interests. Israel's operational pause in sharing intelligence with the Palestinian Authority reflects deteriorating trust and the risk of leaks compromising West Bank raids.
sections.regional_response: The U.S. blocked an Israeli pre-election strike on Iran, signaling Washington's desire to avoid escalation while maintaining military readiness via tanker deployments. New U.S. sanctions on Iranian-linked financial networks in Canada and the MEXC Global designation demonstrate continued economic pressure on Tehran. Iraq's interception of a large rocket shipment shows Baghdad's willingness to disrupt militia supply lines, possibly under U.S. pressure. Lebanon's controlled explosion and artillery activity indicate ongoing border tensions but no major escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The circulation of a nuclear explosion response guide to Iranian healthcare workers, though unverified, suggests Tehran is preparing civil defense for a potential radiological event. The Iraqi government plane's eight-hour visit to Tehran highlights deepening Baghdad-Tehran coordination amid regional volatility. Israel's decision to withhold operational details from the PA marks a significant shift in security coordination, likely reducing the effectiveness of joint counterterrorism efforts. FinCEN's $16 billion finding against MEXC Global reveals the scale of crypto-facilitated sanctions evasion by Iran, Russia, and North Korea.
